hero.headline: Where Tirana opens its doors to you
hero.subtext: A renovated Albanian villa a short walk from the New Bazaar, with home-cooked dinners, a garden to sit in, and a cobalt blue door that has welcomed travellers, neighbours and stories for decades.

story.label: Our story
story.heading: A partisan base, now a place to rest
story.paragraph1: A marble plaque on the wall outside tells the story plainly: from 1936 to the end of 1943, this house served as a base for revolutionary activity and was one of the key liaison points for the Peza Partisan unit during Albania's National Liberation War.
story.paragraph2: The bones of the building are still the same: thick walls, high ceilings, local paintings on almost every surface. The inside has been carefully opened up into a warm, social place to stay.
story.paragraph3: The neighbourhood is real Tirana: bakeries, corner cafes and neighbours who say hello, with Skanderbeg Square and the New Bazaar an easy walk away.
story.door_motto: A base for the Peza Partisans, 1936-1943.

amenities.label: Amenities
amenities.heading: Everything you need, nothing you don't

items.title: Free breakfast daily
items.text: Vegetarian friendly, plus Nana's traditional dinners most nights.

items.title: Towels included
items.text: No extra fees, no deposits. Just ask at reception.

items.title: Personal lockers
items.text: Spacious lockers with a key provided for every guest.

items.title: A/C + privacy curtains
items.text: Air conditioning throughout and a curtain on every bed.

items.title: Garden, terrace & bar
items.text: Albanian raki, local wine and cold beer. The place where most evenings and new friendships start.

items.title: Shared kitchen
items.text: Cook your own, or join whatever's on the stove.

items.title: Free Wi-Fi
items.text: Fast enough to work, plan or upload the whole trip.

items.title: Games room
items.text: Ping pong and darts: rivalries strongly encouraged.

items.title: Bicycle parking
items.text: Safe spot for your bike; Tirana is flat and rideable.

items.title: Bag storage
items.text: Early arrival or late bus? Leave your bag with us.

items.title: Working spaces
items.text: Quiet corners and fast Wi-Fi for remote workers and planners.

items.title: Laundry service
items.text: Keep your bag light and we will sort the rest.

items.title: Airport shuttle
items.text: On-demand pickup and drop-off to Tirana International Airport. Just ask us in advance.

items.title: 3rd floor lounge & veranda
items.text: A quiet living room on the top floor with an open veranda. The best spot for a morning coffee or a late-night chat.

events.label: Events
events.heading: Something's always happening
events.description: We are not a party hostel; we are a social one. If you arrive in Tirana alone, you won't stay that way. There is something on almost every night, and it always starts the same way: someone in the common room asking if you want to join.

items.title: Karaoke nights
items.text: Nobody is good. Everybody sings.

items.title: Trivia evenings
items.text: Mixed teams: you will know half the room by round three.

items.title: Albanian Nights
items.text: Raki, folk music and stories from our staff.

items.title: Cooking classes
items.text: Learn byrek and other family favourites with Nana.

items.title: Movie nights
items.text: Projector on the terrace when the weather plays along.

items.title: BBQs
items.text: Garden grill, long tables, everyone invited.

items.title: Day trips & walking tours
items.text: Bunk'Art, Dajti Mountain and the New Bazaar.

items.title: Stand-up comedy
items.text: Local and traveller comedians. The crowd is always mixed.

reviews.label: Reviews
reviews.heading: Guests keep saying the same things

quotes.text: Incredible stay at Blue Door Hostel. Felt so at home and relaxed in the space. The staff were absolutely amazing. Nana's cooking was fantastic. The dinners and the breakfasts were absolutely amazing. It was the first hostel that I've genuinely loved the social atmosphere they've created.

We absolutely loved it here, we extended our stay and would have stayed longer if they hadn't been fully booked. Not only is the location an easy walk from the city center, nightlife, and the sights, but the staff made this place next level. The hostel has everything you need, balancing a super fun social vibe with enough space to relax. Our highlights were the homecooked meal and quiz night.

This place is fantastic, everything you need from a great hostel. Awesome breakfast, everything is clean, comfortable bed, plenty of space, social atmosphere, showers warm and clean, they even have ear plugs in the rooms. The breakfast is very good and they run tours as well. Highly recommend.

Amazing hostel that I would absolutely recommend to everybody travelling to Tirana. Nightly dinners are delicious, fresh, and a great way to meet new people. Beds are super comfy. 10 minute walk from the city center.
Great stay, super chill. One of the staff carried my really heavy bag up the stairs. Hostel was clean, breakfast was lovely and the place was amazing.

items.name: Room 1
items.text: A social mixed dorm. The room where most people end up staying longer than planned.

items.name: Room 2

items.name: Room 3

items.name: Room 4 (Female Only)
items.text: A dedicated dorm for women travelling solo or together. Same comfort, quieter atmosphere.

items.name: Private room
items.text: Your own door to close, with the common room and garden still just a few steps away.

items.q: What are the check-in and check-out times?
items.a: Check-in is from 11:30 AM and reception is open until midnight. Check-out is before 11:00 AM. If you arrive early or leave late, we are happy to store your bags free of charge. Just ask at reception.

You can cancel free of charge up to 24 hours before your arrival date. Cancellations made less than 24 hours before check-in are subject to a one-night charge. Policies may vary slightly by room type, so check your booking confirmation for the exact terms.
Yes, a free breakfast is included every morning. It is vegetarian friendly and made fresh daily. Most evenings Nana also prepares a traditional Albanian dinner available to all guests at a low cost.
Yes, towels are included in the price. No extra fees, no deposits. Just ask at reception when you arrive.

items.q: How do I get from Tirana Airport to the hostel?
items.a: The airport is around 15 km away, roughly a 30-minute drive. We offer airport pickup on request, so contact us in advance to arrange it. Alternatively, taxis and ride-share apps are widely available and affordable.
We accept cash in Albanian Lek or Euro, as well as credit and debit cards. Please note that the city tourist tax is not included in the room price and is paid separately at check-in.

items.q: Is there a minimum age to stay?
items.a: Blue Door Hostel is an adult-oriented social hostel. Guests must be at least 18 years old to stay in the dorm rooms. Families with children may enquire about private room availability.
Unfortunately we do not accept pets at the hostel.
Reception is open from 8:00 AM until midnight every day. If you plan to arrive outside these hours, please let us know in advance so we can make arrangements for your check-in.
Yes, fast Wi-Fi is available throughout the hostel at no charge, reliable enough for remote work, video calls and uploading your whole trip.

schedule.label: Weekly schedule
schedule.heading: Something every night of the week
schedule.description: A fixed weekly programme so you can plan your stay around the nights that matter. Some evenings we team up with our friends at Bearded Dad Hostel across town.

staffpicks.label: Local tips
staffpicks.heading: Staff picks: the Tirana we actually live in
staffpicks.description: Every city looks different when you know where the locals go. Here is what our team sends guests to before they even ask.

items.tip: A converted old mill with a huge terrace. Best coffee in the neighbourhood and always full of locals, never tourists.
The New Bazaar, five minutes on foot. Go in the morning for fresh byrek, cheese and produce. The best €2 breakfast in Tirana.
A bar dedicated to Albanian tradition. Order a raki flight and let the staff explain what you are drinking. Loud, fun and very local.
Once the Communist Party elite's private neighbourhood, now the city's bar and restaurant district. Walk in any direction after 10pm.
Take the cable car up, departing from 20 minutes away by cab. The view over Tirana at sunset is the one photo everyone takes home.
A Cold War nuclear bunker turned museum, a 10-minute walk away. Genuinely fascinating and unlike anything else in the Balkans.

footer.tagline: A symbol of peace and prosperity in Tirana, Albania.
